generationMode: manager-local deterministic extraction from git objects; no product source edits
commands: read-only source queries for literal registry, native route/detect/plan, validators, harness adapters, framework markers, and fact inputs
runIdNote: The source inventory was generated by read-only git-object/source queries; no external harness run ID is fabricated. Compiler and Enforcer gate run IDs are reported in the manager handoff.

parserVariants.definition: Distinct variants declared by enforcer-memory::parsers::Language at the exact source SHA.

structuralLanguages.definition: Declared Language variants whose parse_file match arm returns Some(ParsedFile); this is parser-dispatch shape, not semantic structural coverage.

explicitNoneDispatch.definition: Declared Language variants whose parse_file match arm returns None.

grammarCargoDeclarations.definition: Direct tree-sitter dependency declarations in enforcer-memory/Cargo.toml, including the core crate.

grammarBindings.definition: Distinct direct tree-sitter grammar dependency names excluding the core tree-sitter crate.

grammarProviderExpressions.definition: Source occurrences and distinct provider expressions observed under enforcer-memory/src/languages during UL00 read-only audit; this denominator is separate from Cargo declarations.

vendoredGrammarFiles.definition: Tracked files below enforcer-memory/vendor at the exact source SHA.

vendorGrammarTopLevelDirs.definition: Distinct first-level grammar directories below enforcer-memory/vendor at the exact source SHA.

langSpecRows.definition: LangSpec language rows in enforcer-memory/src/languages/spec.rs from the UL00 audit.

langSpecUnitFixtures.definition: Language unit fixture files in enforcer-memory/src/languages from the UL00 audit.

evidence.role: parser identities, extension dispatch, parse-shape dispatch

proves: 160 declared language identities are preserved as one row per source enum variant.
156 parser-dispatch Some rows and the four explicit None rows are distinguished.
Grammar Cargo declarations, distinct binding denominator, tracked vendor file count, and top-level vendor directory count are explicitly named.
Surface crosswalk counts are labeled as partial inventory evidence rather than semantic coverage.
Every row uses only the closed capability states proved, partial, unsupported, blocked, or not-applicable.
doesNotProve: Parser or grammar presence is not semantic-rule coverage.
The inventory does not prove end-to-end route reachability, native validator execution, third-party tool availability, or fact completeness.
The inventory does not authorize UL01 or any product-source work beyond the explicitly approved UL00 files.
Hand-maintained counts outside this artifact are not authoritative.
